scenario_name: Campus Innovation Day compound infrastructure incident
description: Compound local power, network distribution, and canteen water failures begin at 10:00. No service is restored unless a mapped work request finishes and its verification passes.

rules.degraded_service: not_usable_for normal operation unless explicit activity mode accepts it
rules.restoration: service becomes available at work completion plus verification; prerequisites must be satisfied
